_comment: The word-level gates, in your hands rather than buried in preflight.py. /setup seeds this from the truth-rule interview and you add to it every time you catch a wording you don't want back. Everything here is checked against the BUILT PDF's text.

banned_vocab._comment: Rule 4d — words that do impression management rather than work. WARN, not FAIL, because the rule exempts skills-line headers and genuine terms of art: a build can justify one in notes.md. The list below is a generic starting set; add the ones that keep creeping into your own drafts.

rejected_wordings._comment: Rule 4a and the truth rules — FAIL. Two kinds of entry live here. (1) A wording you already settled on, so a re-derived variant gets caught and replaced with the version you chose. (2) A claim that overstates what you actually did. The second kind is the important one: it is the mechanism that stops a tailoring pass quietly promoting you. /setup writes your first entries from the honesty questions it asks in phase 4.

spelling._comment: Set by config.json's locale.spelling. en-GB makes the American column a FAIL; en-US inverts it; null disables the gate. The point is consistency, not nationality — a page that mixes both reads as careless.
